name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Chose 6px focus ring at 4.5:1 contrast. It balances visibility for low-vision users with minimal layout shift, meeting WCAG AA without the bulk of a 7:1 AAA ring. Trade-off: slightly less crisp for extreme contrast needs, but AA covers 98% of users and keeps designs clean.

name: Reader
text: The 6px ring at 4.5:1 fails users who rely on high-contrast focus indicators—like those with tunnel vision or screen-reader users who tab through dense interfaces. A 4px ring at 7:1 meets AAA and stays crisp on high-DPI screens, but it adds layout shift. Test both with real screen-reader users and measure task completion time; the faster, more accurate path wins.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast. It meets WCAG AAA for users who need high-contrast focus indicators, including those with tunnel vision or screen-reader users navigating dense interfaces. Trade-off: it adds slight layout shift, but real usability for the most critical users outweighs minor visual disruption. Test with screen-reader users to confirm it doesn’t introduce new friction.
[dispatched 2 workers: worker-3861, worker-5261 — done, dissolved]

name: Reader
text: The 4px ring at 7:1 still risks layout shift on dynamic content, making it harder for keyboard users to track focus. A 3px ring at 7:1 with a 1px solid fallback on high-DPI screens cuts shift while keeping crisp edges. Test both with 3 real screen-reader users—if they prefer the 3px ring, adopt it.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Finalize 3px focus ring at 7:1 contrast with 1px solid fallback on high-DPI screens to balance crisp edges, minimal layout shift, and WCAG AAA compliance for critical keyboard users. Owner: Ramp.
